title: All Grygla Elementary 5th-grade students participated in 2024-25 MCA science assessment
text:
All Grygla Elementary 5th-grade students participated in 2024-25 MCA science assessment
The Minnesota Department of Education notes that only Grygla Elementary School’s fifth-graders were assessed in the science component of the 2024-25 MCA, as reported by the department.
All eight students who completed this part of the test at Grygla Elementary were enrolled in the fifth grade.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are statewide exams designed to measure progress toward Minnesota’s academic standards and satisfy both federal and state legislative mandates. These assessments include math, reading, and science, depending on the grade tested. Most students take the MCA, while eligible students receiving special education services may complete the Alt MCA.
According to Minnesota's Report Card, overall proficiency on Minnesota's MCA exams has declined from pre-pandemic levels. Math proficiency dropped by more than 7% since 2019, while reading proficiency decreased almost 5%.
Information for this story was sourced from the Minnesota Department of Education. Source data is available here.
